glosses: An attitude or a feeling of distaste or aversion.

examples.text: In deference to Queen Victoria's dislike of high speed, the specials were allowed about 75 min. for the journey on the Deeside line, but after her death, they were slightly accelerated.

glosses: Something that a person dislikes (has or feels aversion to).

examples.text: Tell me your likes and dislikes.

examples.text: In the thick of the railway controversies of his day, Francis naturally had his prejudices. It seems that he cordially disliked the aristocracy in general.

examples.text: Rebecca Black's "Friday" video has gained notoriety for being one of the most disliked videos in YouTube history.

glosses: Opposition or repugnance of mind; fixed dislike often without any conscious reasoning.

examples.text: Due to her aversion to the outdoors she complained throughout the entire camping trip.

glosses: An object of dislike or repugnance.

examples.text: Pushy salespeople are a major aversion of mine.

glosses: The act of turning away from an object.

examples.text: She soon married again, to spite her ex-husband.
